past.note: Ingest estimates plus conservative recall allowances, including failed setup attempts; not a reconciled provider invoice.

modal.note: Eight 120-second native workers plus two 60-second Python workers. Runtime also includes setup and verification. Reservations include failed prelaunch reservations; do not infer billed cost from them.

tinker.note: The entire conservative allowance remains held pending attribution. No further model call is authorized by this allocation.

attribution_gap: Read-only usage exports returned no attributed rows at capture time; empty rows are not zero charges.
budget_coordination: Disjoint static allocation subtracts full BoundForge allowances and forecasting guards; other projects do not read CodeGarden's job ledger.
provider_remaining_balances: Account-wide snapshots are in shared-allocation.json. Concurrent usage makes them different from the remaining CodeGarden allocation; no fresh exact balance is asserted here.
